disabled.title: Kinds Veil leaves alone
disabled.description: Built-in kinds not to hide, e.g. NAME or IP. People can't turn these back on.

allow.title: Values that stay visible
allow.description: Exact text (any case), a wildcard such as *@yourcompany.com, or a regular expression written as /.../flags.

patterns.title: Extra things to hide
patterns.description: Company-specific values such as project codes or customer IDs.

type.description: Placeholder name: capitals and underscores, e.g. PROJECT_CODE.

allowTurningOff.title: Let people switch Veil off
allowTurningOff.description: When false, people can't switch Veil off on a site or stop it hiding a kind.
